correctness.rationale: The gamma identity for H^m on jump functions leads to a nonnegative kernel with integral E_m(s)=s sum_{k=1}^m (log(1/s))^k/k!. Its derivative in u=log(1/s) equals exp(-u)(1-u^m/m!), proving unique maximizer. Signed BV measure decomposition yields the exact operator norm and equality classification. The Stirling/geometric remainder argument proves the stated asymptotic; the actual standalone checker independently tested special cases, signed multijumps and asymptotics.

value.rationale: A canonical, iterated positive averaging operator is calibrated by an exact, attained BV-to-L1 identity-defect norm for every order. The unique factorial-root jump location and exponentially small large-order deficiency establish a structural boundary-layer law for discontinuity-bearing signals. This is a natural motivated sharp invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
